title: Pinchas of Habata (the stonecutter)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: In the Sifrei (Emor, כה), it is said of him that his lot fell to become High Priest. The treasurers went and found him quarrying, and they filled the quarry for him with gold dinars. R. Ch. ben Gamliel said: “Was he a stonecutter? Was he not our son-in-law? They found him only plowing.”[^1] In the Tosefta, Yoma chapter 1, the reading is “Ish Chavata.”[^2]

notes.text: The personal name in אר״ח בן גמליאל is abbreviated to ח, “Ch.”
Hyman’s reference is ספרי אמור־כה; the work and modern section number are uncertain. The heading הבתה (Habata) differs from the Tosefta form חבתה (Chavata).
